description: RESEARCH-ONLY (is_gate:false, routes_in_production:false, un-wired). Detects validation/guard parity gaps between SIBLING functions in DIFFERENT contracts of the same module — e.g. per-action library protocols (validateX/executeX libraries) where one action guards an eligibility flag and a sibling action operating on the same shared object omits it. Anchored on Size Credit M-06 (BuyCreditMarket.validateBuyCreditMarket guards `!creditPosition.forSale`; SellCreditMarket.validateSellCreditMarket reads the same creditPosition but omits the forSale guard). Complements the intra-contract sibling_function_parity lens (which cannot pair across contracts). High precision over recall; multi-gate cross-sibling test keeps FP low. NEVER mints or routes.

fp_controls.multi_gate_cross_sibling: a candidate requires ALL of: same action-verb prefix, same module directory (file parent), a shared storage-struct first parameter type, and >=2 shared called functions (shared subject). This is a far stronger sibling gate than intra-contract pairing, needed because cross-contract pairs are inherently noisier.
fp_controls.eligibility_guard_field_focus: high confidence reserved for a missing GUARD on an eligibility-style flag (forSale/paused/disabled/...) that the strong sibling checks and the weak sibling omits while operating on the same shared object
fp_controls.view_functions_included: unlike the intra-contract lens, validator functions are view/pure and ARE the target; mutation is NOT required, shared-subject calls replace the mutating-path gate
fp_controls.weak_must_be_external: the omitting (weak) sibling must be external/public
fp_controls.wrapper_suppression: if one sibling forwards to the other, suppress
fp_controls.both_admin_suppression: if both siblings are admin-gated, asymmetry is intended
fp_controls.controlled_component_filter: missing component tokens must be eligibility-vocab guard fields or components[] calls; uppercase-initial tokens (events/interface casts) and exclude_components are dropped
